custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have four parts: part A tracked with Avg Cost $7.00, part B untracked with Avg Cost $9.00, part C untracked with Avg Cost $3.00 and part D tracked with Avg Cost $9.00.
  • Give parts A, B, C and D descriptions that start with the same text and end, in turn, with ALPHA, BRAVO, DELTA and ECHO.
  • Give parts A, B, C and D part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all four.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425643-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425643-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A, B, C and D are listed.

Step 2:

  • The Avg Cost header shows a sort arrow.
  • Low to high, the rows read part C ($3.00), part A ($7.00), part B ($9.00), part D ($9.00); high to low they read part B ($9.00), part D ($9.00), part A ($7.00), part C ($3.00). One of these two orders shows.
  • Parts B and D share $9.00, so part B (BRAVO) comes before part D (ECHO).
  • The untracked parts B and C sit where their cost puts them, not below the tracked parts.

Step 3:

  • The arrow turns round and the other of the two orders shows, with part B still before part D.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State)

  • S6-R8: “Sorting by any other column sorts by that column first, then by description, A to Z. Tracking state plays no part in it.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10819 acceptance criteria: “Given the list is sorted by Average Cost, when it loads, then it is ordered by cost first and description second, with tracking state playing no part.”
